name: Future Mikuru
source: A future version of [url=/c71230]Asahina Mikuru[/url], from a farther future than the one the original version was from, in order to tell him two things: "Snow White", a clue that helps [url=/c71227]Kyon[/url] get out of an alternate universe he is trapped in with [url=/c71228]Suzumiya Haruhi[/url], and not to get too close to her past self.
translation: A future version of [url=/c71230]Asahina Mikuru[/url], from a farther future than the one the original version was from, in order to tell him two things: "Snow White", a clue that helps [url=/c71227]Kyon[/url] get out of an alternate universe he is trapped in with [url=/c71228]Suzumiya Haruhi[/url], and not to get too close to her past self.
